title: A Randomized Controlled Trial on the Effect of Retrograde Partial Bladder Fill on Time to Discharge and Overall Medical Staff Satisfaction
brief_summary: This study is a randomized controlled trial on the effect of retrograde partial bladder fill on time to discharge in patients who have had urological surgery for BPH, and whether it affects overall medical staff satisfaction.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any male patient between ages 20-80 with foley catheter indwelled after urological surgery performed at our institution

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any patient that does not remove foley catheter at discharge
